guides.title: 鍺矽雪崩光偵測器：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Germanium-silicon avalanche photodetectors: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 雪崩增益伴隨雜訊與偏壓依賴。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Avalanche gain brings noise and bias dependence. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。此 GBIC 監測光二極體照片不能證明 Ge-Si 材料、APD 結構或雪崩倍增。 右側為雷射小晶粒，左側較大晶粒為監測光二極體；不是整合鍺光偵測器的材料證據。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：雪崩增益伴隨雜訊與偏壓依賴。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用增益、過量雜訊及崩潰電壓共同驗證。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This GBIC monitor-photodiode photo does not establish Ge-Si material, APD structure or avalanche gain. The smaller right-hand die is the laser and the larger left-hand die the monitor photodiode; this does not establish an integrated germanium detector.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Avalanche gain brings noise and bias dependence. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Jointly validate gain, excess noise and breakdown voltage. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用增益、過量雜訊及崩潰電壓共同驗證」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Jointly validate gain, excess noise and breakdown voltage, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 鍺矽雪崩光偵測器：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Germanium-silicon avalanche photodetectors: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「劃分吸收與乘增區：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。Ge 可負責長波長吸收，Si 乘增區提供合適高場；兩區電場需求不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate absorption and multiplication regions: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Ge can absorb long-wavelength light while Si supplies multiplication; their field requirements differ. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜劃分吸收與乘增區：模型與設計：畫材料、光生成與高場位置，核對載子走向。
觀察站 2｜建立完整噪聲預算：模型與設計：在相同噪聲頻寬比較低增益和高增益的總 SNR。
觀察站 3｜交付接收器適用性：量測與判別：在同一資料速率與誤碼定義下比較數個增益工作點。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate absorption and multiplication regions: model and design: Map materials, photogeneration and high field and check carrier travel.
Observation station 2 | Build a full noise budget: model and design: Compare total SNR at low/high gain using the same noise bandwidth.
Observation station 3 | Deliver receiver suitability evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare gain operating points at common data rate and error definition.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立完整噪聲預算：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付接收器適用性：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build a full noise budget: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver receiver suitability evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「吸收與乘增必須在同一材料同一位置」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「信號增加十倍就表示 SNR 增加十倍」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Absorption and multiplication must occur at one material/location" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Tenfold signal always means tenfold SNR" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 以公開光子研發與封裝機構為地理代表，討論Ge 吸收／Si 乘增分工、增益與過量噪聲如何由單一元件走向可量測、可封裝的系統。地圖沿用本學院矽光子課程的代表據點，並非此技術唯一發源地或所有文獻實驗位置。
courses.summaryEn: A public photonic research/packaging institution provides geographic context for translating Ge absorption/Si multiplication, gain and excess noise from a component into a measurable packaged system. The map uses the academy’s silicon-photonics reference location, not the sole invention site or every cited laboratory.

history.title: 從元件演示到可重現介面
history.titleEn: From component demonstration to reproducible interfaces
history.text: 公開研究與模擬教學逐步把Ge 吸收／Si 乘增分工、增益與過量噪聲連到基準、容差與封裝驗證。本課沿此方法脈絡安排作業，不宣稱單一機構獨創整項技術。
history.textEn: Public research and simulation tutorials connect Ge absorption/Si multiplication, gain and excess noise to reference conditions, tolerances and package validation. The course follows that methodological progression without assigning invention to one institution.

history.title: 跨元件與封裝的共同驗證
history.text: 相同光學性能需在固定、溫變與電性連接之後重新檢查；原始研究結果與量產資格是不同證據層級。
history.textEn: Recheck optical behavior after attachment, temperature change and electrical connection; research results and production qualification are different evidence levels.
